question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks belong to the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: List every distinct country our customers live in (one column: country).
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices, rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many albums by the artist AC/DC are in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees does the company have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

question: What is the average unit price of a track, rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) FROM Track

question: How many invoices were billed to Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: How many distinct countries do our customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer

question: Which 4 artists have the most tracks? Return artist name and track count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 4

question: What are the top 5 billing countries by total invoice revenue? Return country and revenue rounded to 2 decimals, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Return their full name as one column ('First Last') and the total rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which genre generated the most revenue from invoice lines (unit price times quantity)? Return the genre name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show total invoice revenue per calendar year, oldest year first. Return year (as YYYY text) and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Which sales support agent's customers have spent the most? Return the employee's full name as one column ('First Last') and the total rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 genres have the longest average track length? Return genre name and average length in minutes rounded to 2 decimals, longest first.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS minutes FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many customers does each support representative look after? Return the rep's full name as one column ('First Last') and the customer count.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: List the titles of all albums that have more than 20 tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

question: Which 3 months had the highest invoice revenue? Return the month as YYYY-MM and revenue rounded to 2 decimals, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: For invoices billed to the USA, which genre sold the most units? Return genre name and units sold.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE i.BillingCountry = 'USA' GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which three employees were hired first? Return full name as one column ('First Last'), earliest hire first.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Employee ORDER BY HireDate LIMIT 3

question: How many different customers have bought at least one Jazz track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'
